[Rating: 1/10] Pain.  This game is nothing but pain.  Actually, this isn't even a game.  It's mostly just randomness without the pleasant feel of dice.

[Rating: 1/10] It's just blind guessing: whoever has more luck, wins. Horribly boring (I thought it even when I was a kid).

[Rating: 1/10] I usually give games like this a bump up in my ratings by virtue of the fact I can play them with my kids.  However, this game is just SOOOO boring.  I could play it with my kids, but I might not personally survive the boredom.  I didn't like it as a kid either, so maybe I'm biased.  If I HAVE to play, I usually amuse myself by calling coordinates that  spell out secret messages.

[Rating: 1/10] Like shooting fish in a barrel, except the fish are minnows, the barrel is a half-mile in diameter, and you're wearing a blindfold.

[Rating: 1/10] G7... miss, A4... miss, F3... hit, D5... miss, F4... miss  Does that sound fun to you?

[Rating: 1/10] Played zounds of times at schoold or whenever we just have a paper and a pencil. Hope not to do it again :)

[Rating: 1/10] Terrible.  Guess!  And then guess again!  You sunk my battleship!  Here's my rules for board-free travel Battleship:  each of you thinks of seventeen consecutive numbers between one and one hundred.  Take turns guessing until someone gets them all.

[Rating: 1/10] [2018-04] This is a really bad game as everything in this is based on luck. Rating: 1

[Rating: 1/10] You would have better fun and better results guessing the result of a coin toss for forty minutes.

[Rating: 1/10] One of the first computer games I played on Windows 3.1. I actually taught my dad this when I was 6 years old, and we'd play on pen and paper while traveling in China, to the bemusement of all my relatives.  0.5+0.5

[Rating: 1/10] I'm amazed that there are so many versions of this crappy game. I guess it can teach little kids how to plot points on a graph, but other than that, it pretty much has no other redeeming value.
